caseName: Smith ex rel. Smith v. Gladden
caseNameFull: OREGON ex rel. SMITH v. GLADDEN, WARDEN
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Robert Y. Thornton, Attorney General of Oregon, and Harold W. Adams, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
